mechanism: Recent acceleration may persist: halve tickets still rising over the last three signal-known sessions
Signal-session selling rejection may precede a fade: halve tickets closing in the upper half of their daily range
A gain concentrated in one daily impulse may be less durable: halve gains not at least half explained by their largest daily dollar jump
Abating participation may indicate exhaustion: halve tickets with signal volume above their prior-20-session mean
Do not add full common-factor exposure while existing live short inventory has negative unrealized price PnL at signal close
Use the existing entry delay to halve unconfirmed fades whose fill-day 15:55 checkpoint is not below signal close
